recalls.summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  The transmission oil cooler hose may have been incorrectly cured, allowing transmission fluid to leak.
Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2021 Jeep Cherokee Latitude and Jeep Cherokee Limited vehicles.  One or both of the front lower control arms may fracture while driving.

Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the right-side curtain air bag may prevent the air bag from deploying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard
Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Jeep Cherokee vehicles. The power transfer unit (PTU) may fail.
